paragraphs.text: Ramaz is a shamanic human planeswalker and crazed visionary who was responsible for manipulating Chandra Nalaar into stealing the Dragon Scroll , which eventually led to the rise of the Eldrazi on Zendikar .

After the event on Zendikar, Chandra bounced from plane to plane searching for clues as to who Ramaz was. She was intent on seeking her vengeance. Knowing just enough about her target, she tracked his progress across multiple planes, often retreading old grounds she had previously visited. Her goal was finally met on the plane of Kaldheim where she confronted the insane shaman. After a skirmish he escaped, revealing that he had only been a minion in a yet greater scheme, subservient to the mysterious dragon whose voice he followed.
Ramaz was only seen in the Duels of the Planeswalkers 2014 game.
